name: cauce
description: One core for Claude Code: routes each task to the right model, effort and capabilities, escalates on evidence, and remembers what failed across repositories.

livespec.title: livespec code index
livespec.description: Use livespec throughout the flow: index the repository, route on what the index shows, brief every worker with a code map, give workers livespec's tools, and report what a change touched. On by default; runs the pinned release through uvx when livespec is not installed.

parallel.title: Haiku decides what runs in parallel
parallel.description: A task queued behind running work starts beside it when Haiku finds it independent of everything running and queued ahead; otherwise it waits its turn. Off: one task at a time per repository.

autowork.title: Start queued work at once
autowork.description: A task queued with ++ starts the repository's dispatcher right away, so it runs in a worker without anyone typing cauce work. Off: queued work waits for cauce work.

names.title: Haiku names sessions
names.description: Haiku names each session of an enrolled project after what it has been asked, in .cauce/sessions.json. A name you edit there is kept.
